request.spec:
The header shows the signed-in user's crew total when a person with the user's name leads a
crew: the due-totals of the crews they lead, added up; nothing otherwise.
request.prompt:
You are implementing ONE change to this application.

FIRST read AGENTS.md — it states the working rules and how the app is tested, and sends you to
DESIGN.md for the app's stack and conventions. Follow both.

THE CHANGE REQUEST:
The header shows the signed-in user's crew total when a person with the user's name leads a
crew: the due-totals of the crews they lead, added up; nothing otherwise.

Your work is verified by an automated Playwright UI test already installed under e2e/specs/.
Read that spec: it declares the exact data-testid anchors, values, test data and any audit
records it expects — match them. Run `bin/e2e` to build the app, start it, and run the test as

AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, DESIGN.md, e2e/support/ or the test spec.

agent.result_text:
The header now shows the signed-in user's crew total in `my-crew-due-total`, and `bin/e2e` passes all 4 tests in the spec.

The new value adds up the due-totals of every crew led by the user's person on the sheet. It's blank when that person leads no crew, or when no person on the sheet matches the user.

- **Matching the user to a person:** this works like "My due": by name or alias, ignoring case and surrounding spaces. In the test, `uma` counts as leading the Green crew because Cam has the alias "Uma".
- **Same sum as the crew rows:** I moved the crew due-total calculation into one shared function, `crewDueTotal()` in `core/crews.ts`. The crew rows and the header both use it, so they always agree.
- **Front end only:** the server already sends each crew's lead and members, and the test expects no new audit lines, so the store, server and audit file are unchanged.

If two people on a sheet both match the user's name, only the first match's crews count. "My due" works the same way, and I kept them consistent.

The edits are in `features/summary/header-counters.ts`, `features/people/people-list.ts`, `features/crews/crew-row.ts` and `core/crews.ts`.
